follow_up_questions.title: Hemoptysis and constitutional symptoms
follow_up_questions.question: Have you coughed up any blood, or had unexplained weight loss, night sweats, fevers or loss of appetite?
follow_up_questions.why: These are red flags for malignancy or infection in a patient with a 2 cm lung nodule and were not asked.

follow_up_questions.title: Smoking pack-year quantification
follow_up_questions.question: How many packs per day did you smoke, and for how many years in total?
follow_up_questions.why: Pack-years are needed to estimate malignancy risk and guide nodule management, and the amount was not asked.

follow_up_questions.title: Perioperative methotrexate management
follow_up_questions.question: Have you been told whether to hold methotrexate before surgery, and are you taking any other immunosuppressants, steroids or blood thinners?
follow_up_questions.why: Immunosuppression affects wound healing and infection risk and needs a perioperative plan.

follow_up_questions.title: Exposure and travel history
follow_up_questions.question: Have you had any exposure to TB, fungal infections, asbestos, or other occupational or environmental exposures (including hay or mold) or recent travel?
follow_up_questions.why: Exposures and prior imaging help determine whether the nodule is infectious, which matters especially on methotrexate.
